title: Runs under a leading choice bit
statement: Let $M$ be a nondeterministic multi-tape Turing machine, let $b$ be a Boolean choice bit, let $w$ be a finite Boolean word, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on a fixed input. Running $M$ from $c$ under the word consisting of $b$ followed by $w$ gives the same configuration as running it under $w$ from the configuration reached by one step under $b$.
hypotheses_covered: A configuration $c$ on a fixed input.
replaced:
Let $M$ be a nondeterministic multi-tape Turing machine, $c$ a configuration of $M$ on some
input, $b \in \{0,1\}$ a choice bit, and $w$ a choice word.  Running $M$ from $c$ under the
word $b w$ gives the same configuration as running $M$ under $w$ from the configuration
reached by one step of $M$ from $c$ under the choice bit $b$.
